name: R2Sign public statistically sampled corpus

The malware population contains 8878 valid labelled PE candidates after fixed-priority family assignment
The 447-sample malware split uses predeclared family quotas, deterministic SHA-256 ranking, and a fifth-sample holdout interval
Mutations are generated deterministically from the declared training samples
